findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Defs.lean:820 `noncomputable def ofBijective (f : α → β) (hf : Bijective f) : α ≃ β`; :826 `coe_ofBijective ... := rfl`; :831 `ofBijective_apply_symm_apply (f) (hf) (x) : f ((ofBijective f hf).symm x) = x`.
findings.fix: Define `equivRootSet := Equiv.ofBijective (fun i ↦ ⟨x i, hx.mem_rootSet_iff.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩) ⟨fun i j h ↦ hinj (congrArg Subtype.val h), fun a ↦ (hx.mem_rootSet_iff.1 a.2).imp fun i hi ↦ Subtype.ext hi⟩`. `coe_equivRootSet` stays `rfl` (`Equiv.coe_ofBijective`), and `equivRootSet_symm_apply` becomes `congrArg Subtype.val (Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply _ _ a)`.
findings.issue: `equivRootSet` builds the equiv from raw `toFun`/`invFun`/`left_inv`/`right_inv` with `Classical.choose`, re-deriving `Equiv.ofBijective`; `equivRootSet_symm_apply` (line 129) then reproves `Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply`.

findings.evidence: Lines 79-89: both proofs reduce to `rw [← Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_univ_val_equiv]`; `comp_perm` is exactly the `mpr` of `comp_perm_iff`.
findings.fix: Keep `comp_perm_iff` and define `theorem comp_perm (hx : IsRootEnumeration f x) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) : IsRootEnumeration f (x ∘ σ) := (comp_perm_iff σ).2 hx`.
findings.issue: `comp_perm` and `comp_perm_iff` (line 85) are proved separately by the same `← Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_univ_val_equiv` rewrite; the `@[simp]` iff already gives the implication.

findings.evidence: Line 58-61 `IsRootEnumeration f x ↔ (f.map (algebraMap F L)).roots = Multiset.map x univ.val := Iff.rfl`, identical to the body at line 55; grep shows no use of `isRootEnumeration_iff` anywhere in `code/`.
findings.fix: Delete `isRootEnumeration_iff`; the definition at line 54 already is the equation, and the one packaging lemma (`Polynomial.Separable.isRootEnumeration`) is the bridge consumers need.
findings.issue: `isRootEnumeration_iff` is `Iff.rfl` restating the definition verbatim and has no consumer: the file's own proofs unfold the def directly (`rw [IsRootEnumeration]` line 81, `change` line 87) and `Polynomial.Separable.isRootEnumeration` (line 139) uses defeq instead.

summary: The predicate and its main lemmas are new and reuse Mathlib correctly, but `equivRootSet` hand-rolls `Equiv.ofBijective` (including a redundant `equivRootSet_symm_apply`), `comp_perm` reproves its own `comp_perm_iff`, and `isRootEnumeration_iff` is an unused `Iff.rfl` restatement of the definition.
